# me.mubx.dev

> Omar Mubaidin (MUBX): full-stack web developer and AI engineer in Amman, Jordan, and founder of the MUBX web consultancy.

Omar Mubaidin builds high-performance websites, e-commerce stores and custom web systems with Next.js, React and TypeScript, including Jordanian payment integration (Zain Cash, CliQ) and technical SEO. He is a Computer Science graduate of Al Hussein Technical University (HTU).
